description:
Implement a minimal client for Anthropic's Messages API.

=== What to build ===
- Module (e.g. src/provider/anthropic.rs or src/providers/anthropic/) with:
  - Request type: model_id, max_tokens, system prompt, messages (role + content).
  - Response type: stop_reason, content blocks, usage (input/output tokens).
  - Error type distinguishing: network failure, auth error, rate-limit (429), provider error (5xx), parse error.
- HTTP via reqwest (blocking or tokio — pick one; v0.1 has no concurrency, blocking is cheapest). Justify in commit.
- Auth: reads env var name declared in providers.yaml (§4.1) and sends as x-api-key header.
- Anthropic-version header and content-type set per current API docs.

=== Out of scope ===
- Streaming (v0.1 non-goal; deferred to later milestone).
- Tool use payloads (v0.3).
- Prompt caching (deferred).
- Other providers (bedrock etc. — one provider is enough for v0.1).

=== Testing ===
- Unit tests against a mocked HTTP server (wiremock or httpmock).
- Cover: happy path, 401, 429, 500, malformed JSON.
- No live API calls in tests.

Depends on bl-5bbc (needs loadable providers.yaml to find the env var name).
title: Anthropic messages-API client (non-streaming)
